paragraphs.text: Elham is an Auriok woman on New Phyrexia who was part of the Mirran Resistance .

Elham is an Auriok woman, part of Neyali ’s resistance cell against the Phyrexians in the Furnace Layer of Mirrex . She has white hair accented by white-gold flecks in her skin, giving her an incandescent appearance. As a seasoned and dedicated member of the Mirran Resistance , she bears a prosthetic calf made of polished gold, well-articulated and finely crafted. Elham carries a battleaxe on her shoulder and stands with a determined, no-nonsense demeanor, taking on more burdens than necessary to free her comrades from encumbrance. Her strong sense of duty and solidarity is evident, making her a vital member of Neyali’s cell.

Elham once led the Mirran Resistance cell before Neyali took over, showcasing her leadership and commitment to their cause. Despite stepping down from leadership, Elham remained a central figure, providing support and guidance to Neyali and the others. Elham participated in discussions with Neyali about the potential reasons for Reyana 's disappearance and possible locations. When Neyali decided to rescue Reyana from the Salvage Complex, Elham expressed her readiness to join the dangerous mission. Despite her concerns, she followed Neyali's orders and respected her decision to go down to the pit alone.
